title: Policy Decision
description: Output of the policy engine for a remediation plan. Attached to the evidence bundle to document why an action was allowed, escalated, or denied.

decision_id.description: Unique identifier for this policy evaluation

policy_version.description: Version or commit hash of the policy pack used

allow.description: Whether the plan is allowed to proceed (with or without approval)

require_approval.description: Whether human approval is required before execution

constraints.description: Execution constraints imposed by the policy

risk_score.description: Computed risk score that informed the decision

approval.description: Present only if require_approval was true and approval was obtained

approval_method.description: Channel through which approval was obtained
